races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict: SENSATIONAL FILLY holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to build on her recent Leopardstown second and get off the mark. C&D debut third Ladies Gossip also has better days ahead of her and can chase home Paddy Twomey's promising Mehmas filly ahead of stablemate Corsican Night , who warrants a market check on her debut. SENSATIONAL FILLY (FR) LADIES GOSSIP (IRE) CORSICAN NIGHT (IRE)

races.verdict: SOARING SUN hasn't been at his best on turf since going in over C&D early in the year and is taken to bounce back in style now returned to his favoured polytrack. races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: Lots with chances but AVIATRICE took this prize a year ago and is fancied to repeat the feat on the back of an excellent second here last time. Multiple course winner Carolina Jetstream heads the list of dangers, although a solid case can also be made for Suzie Songs , Leading Dancer and Prevalence .
